purpose: Curator-approved Internet Archive field recordings. These entries may be passed to applyInternetArchiveReview.ts; raw discovery reports may not.

recording.collectionContext: Performed by Deborah Paulukaitis. Recorded on October 8, 2023 in Lilburn, Georgia. Learned from her grandfather, Virgil Matson (b. 1905). Recorded by Adam Paulukaitis on behalf of Derek Piotr.

review.editionEvidence: The source identifies this as a named oral-tradition performance learned from the performer's grandfather, providing a documented traditional rendition of the Appalachian song-tune rather than an unrelated same-title release.

recording.collectionContext: Performed by Guy Wolff. Recorded by Derek Piotr on January 8, 2023 in Bantam, Connecticut. Performed with banjo.

review.editionEvidence: Johnson Boys is a documented Southern Appalachian song-and-fiddle tune in the catalog, and this named banjo field performance is a real traditional-style edition rather than a title-only match.

recording.collectionContext: Performed by Kazuko Toelken. Recorded by Derek Piotr on March 25, 2026 in Skidmore, Texas. Fragment. Learned as a youth from her father, Barre Toelken.

review.editionEvidence: The collection documents a named family-transmitted performance of this catalog's traditional song-and-dance reel, so the fragment is a provenance-rich reference edition instead of an unrelated same-title song.
